description: 4Dublin Pipeline All is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage. The four local authorities in the Dublin Region (comprising Fingal County Council, South Dublin County Council, Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council and Dublin City Council) provide combined quarterly data on new residential planning permissions and housing construction activity. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage. Its tags are 4Dublin, Housing Supply, Planning Applications, task force. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-08-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
